summary: SITE Centers Corp. (registrant) disclosed via Form 8-K that its subsidiary agreed to sell its ground leasehold interest in The Pike Outlets (Long Beach, CA) to Pike Long Beach Owner LLC for ~$50.0 million cash (net proceeds ~$46.0 million). The buyer posted a $1.5 million nonrefundable deposit. The board implicitly supports the sale as management entered the agreement. Closing expected by end of Q3 2026, subject to City of Long Beach consent, tenant estoppels, and standard conditions. No premium or break fee stated. Watch for regulatory approvals and the consent process.
